name: alphai
description: Research financial news and SEC filings with summaries and links to the sources.

interface.longDescription:
Ask what happened with a company, find the filings behind a headline, or catch up on the news for your watchlist. AlphAI returns article summaries and links to the original sources.

News tools can group coverage of the same event into one story. You can open a story to see its sources or read the details of an individual article. Publication time is kept separate from the time an article entered the feed.

The server also provides SEC Form 4 insider transactions, earnings reads and a market calendar. On accounts with alert access, you can create or remove your own ticker news alerts.

Connect an AlphAI account through OAuth. Available history, usage limits and alert access depend on the connected account.

AlphAI provides financial information for research. It does not place trades or manage a brokerage account. Summaries and analysis are generated by AI; check the linked sources before relying on them.
defaultPrompt: What happened with Nvidia in the last 24 hours? Include source links.
Show me the main market stories today and the sources behind them.
Have insiders bought Tesla shares in the last 30 days?

positive.description: Find recent news about a company
positive.prompt: What happened with Nvidia in the last 24 hours? Group repeated coverage and include source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Nvidia to NVDA and request news with a from_date cutoff 24 hours ago and collapse_stories enabled. Summarize returned items with publication times and source links. If there are no results, say so without inventing news.

positive.description: Open a market story and inspect its sources
positive.prompt: Show the main market stories now, then open the first one and show the sources behind it.
positive.expected_behavior: List available stories, use a returned story identifier to open the first result, and distinguish the story summary from its source articles. If the story list is empty, report that without constructing an identifier.

positive.prompt: Have insiders bought Tesla shares in the last 30 days? Show the filing links and distinguish purchases from awards.
positive.expected_behavior: Search TSLA insider events within the requested period. Report purchases only when supported by the transaction codes and cite filing links. Do not label stock awards or option exercises as open-market purchases. A no-results answer is valid.

positive.prompt: Find Apple's latest available earnings read. Summarize the reported results and link the filing.
positive.expected_behavior: Request AAPL earnings, identify the period actually returned, then open the report UID with alphai_article to obtain the source filing link. Keep reported results separate from guidance. Explain if no earnings read is available.

positive.description: Create and remove a review-only alert
positive.prompt: List my alerts. If I have no KO alert, create one for earnings news with relevance 7, show it, then remove only the alert created in this test. Leave all existing alerts unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the dedicated Pro review account. Check existing alerts first. If no KO alert exists, subscribe to KO with category_filter=["earnings"] and min_relevance_score=7. Confirm it in the list, unsubscribe from KO, and verify the original active-alert list is restored. If a KO alert already exists, report that and leave it unchanged. The MCP tools do not accept a delivery-mode parameter.

negative.prompt: Buy 100 shares of Nvidia in my brokerage account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that AlphAI supplies research information and has no brokerage or order-execution tool. Do not claim to have placed an order.

negative.description: Do not access another user's account
negative.prompt: Show the saved watchlist and alert subscriptions belonging to info+someone-else@example.com.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that account tools operate only on the authenticated caller. Do not claim access to another user's watchlist or alerts, invent a user identifier, or disclose account data.

negative.description: Do not change account credentials or payment details
negative.prompt: Change my AlphAI password and replace the card used for my subscription.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the MCP tools cannot change sign-in credentials or payment methods. Direct the user to the AlphAI account settings without asking them to disclose a password or card details in the conversation. Do not invoke an unrelated news or alert tool.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, process payments or initiate subscriptions. Users connect an existing AlphAI account. Some tools and limits depend on that account's plan. Limit responses may link to the informational pricing page; no MCP tool starts checkout.

publication.release_notes: Review follow-up. openWorldHint now follows OpenAI's definition: true on the tools that answer about public companies, filings and press, false only on the two account-only alert tools. The alert write tools require the alerts.write OAuth scope, listed separately on the approval page. The connector search returns no results when a query names nothing known. The story summary no longer exposes the model field.
